limitations: Use complete native Swiss type-B construction-waste disposal as a per-kg screening proxy for the Swiss inert-waste market. Source inert-landfill documentation excludes direct leachate emissions and describes partly sealed sites; native represents 5%-water inert material plus its own disposal delivery. Moisture, landfill class, sealing, closure, emissions, infrastructure and allocation can differ.

The source negative waste reference (-1 kg) and native positive treatment reference (+1 kg) require factor -1. Flip caller exchange sign exactly once, preserve kg magnitude and transform uncertainty sign consistently. This is positive treatment burden, not an avoided-disposal credit. Native disposal/delivery replaces the original source landfill and road/rail model; no extra freight or recovery credit.

Retain caller magnitude, formula, uncertainty shape and separate inventory terms. Native screening differences have unquantified score effects. Only the enumerated ecoinvent 3.6 cut-off scope is reviewed; no other version, consequential route or complete geothermal qualification is implied.
